description: measure-guard: a Claude Code mod that shows the Measure plan state and guards edits, commits, and closeouts (from mods/measure-guard/DESIGN.md)
deviation_notes: Design changes from the brief, recorded in spec.md: (1) the active track is the first [~] track whose plan has a [~] task (the brief's 'first [~] track' denied all edits in this repository); (2) the task goes into conversation notes, not the system prompt (prompt cache); (3) /measure-on was added; (4) a SHA with or without backticks; (5) measure/-only commits pass with no [~] task. Task 1.4 replaced the live smoke test with a fixture sync script (no file access in tests). hooks/load.ts was folded into register.tsx (the $ import rule). The 9 deferred manual verification tasks were verified on 2026-10-05 (git note on ce09fd0); strict mode was covered by the automated tests only. Phase F1 (2 tasks) was added after the live load: /measure-status closes the pane, and Escape closes it.

sprint.goal: Claude Code follows the Measure Task Workflow, because a mod shows the plan state and stops work that the active plan does not cover.
sprint.demo_notes: Live load on 2026-10-05 with claude --plugin-dir: context notes, edit guard deny, end-of-turn report, band, setup question, /measure-off, /measure-on, and the status pane toggle.
